name: qoder-cn
label: Qoder CLI CN
description: Qoder's terminal coding agent, China edition (qoder.com.cn), driven headless
tagline: The China edition of Qoder's terminal agent, on a Qoder CN account (qoder.cn) sign-in or a personal access token. Installed by Qoder's own script.

check_ready.not_ready_message: Not signed in — sign in with `qoderclicn login` (it opens a browser), or paste a personal access token from https://qoder.cn/account/integrations (press e). A qoder.com account does not work here: the China edition signs in to qoder.cn.

env_config.name: QODERCN_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN
env_config.description: Personal access token from https://qoder.cn/account/integrations. Leave blank to use the account signed in with `qoderclicn login` on this machine; a token set here always takes precedence over that sign-in.

env_config.name: QODERCN_MODEL
env_config.description: Model for each run — auto, lite, performance, or a key from `qoderclicn --list-models`. Leave blank for the account default. Other providers' API keys do not work here: models come from the Qoder account.
